testCase.name: [local] S14 Manual aging walk on the server clock: Hospital day 1 → 2 → 3 with real recordings; Nursing Home visits 1 → 4 weeks apart

descriptionHtml:
Bug B35 · P2 · known

Nursing Home keeps the last three visits' transcripts instead of two (TFA-92594 AC 2, UAT 3.6)

Tickets: TFA-92594 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Re-filed from D6 on 2026-10-14 (Quinn). One constant: SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3 in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-16/S11

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S14 Manual aging walk on the server clock: Hospital day 1 → 2 → 3 with real recordings; Nursing Home visits 1 → 4 weeks apart

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U6a Hospital, the part of 'today and yesterday only' that holds under every reading of Q1, Q10 and Q12: on server day D, no bedside recording from D-4 or earlier is listed (archived as '(prior)' or left … (UAT 3.6; TFA-92594 AC 2; UAT TC-13 (day-2 reopen))
  • U6b Hospital edges that depend on Q1 (calendar day vs hour windows: a D-2 or D-3 recording), Q10 (36 h vs 54 h in all for typed dictation: a row archived 35 h ago) and Q12 (prototype per-stay history vs … (UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-92594 AC 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U7 Nursing Home: transcripts are kept for the last two visits. (UAT 3.6; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U9 Time-based rules (what counts as today and yesterday, when a transcript becomes a prior entry, when it leaves) use the server clock. … (UAT 3.8)
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is. (TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Aging helper (server-clock offset) on the local stack and a browser whose clock follows it. Hospital patient: day 1 bedside recording and typed encounter notes; the physician reopens the chart on day 2 and day 3 (server days). Nursing Home resident seen on four visits a week apart, each with dictated visit text

When Hospital: on day 2 record again and open the panel; on day 3 open it without recording. Nursing Home: after each visit's 12 h window has passed, open the Encounter tab

Then Day 2: day 1 is listed on its own as yesterday, with the right date, and no archive button is tapped; the typed day-1 note is gone from the working box and listed (TC-13 day-2 reopen). Day 3: day 1 is gone and day 2 is listed as yesterday. Nursing Home: after V1: V1; after V2: V1, V2; after V3: V2, V3 only; after V4: V3, V4 only

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U1 (no manual step), U6a (day 2), U6b (day 3: calendar vs hours is Q1, prototype vs AC 2 is Q12; judged after those answers), U7 (the real walk; the count rule itself is seeded in S11), T2 (row date = the recording's day), U9 (server day; whose day is Q9). Everything that needs no server-day move is seeded in S10, S11, S17 and S18

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa

After a resident's third and fourth visits the Encounter tab still lists three visits (V1–V3, then V2–V4) instead of the last two.

Evidence: Allure 6678b490, manual TIME lane: 8 of 12 cells passed. The only failing cells are the NH U7 visit-count cells, with the same root as the dev result TC-16/S11 (SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3). The lane ties it to TFA-94699 (in progress). Recorded only, under Q1/Q12: on day 3 the day-1 '(prior)' recording is still listed because it has no archivedAt. The Hospital day 1→2 cells pass.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-16/S11; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S14

Manual aging walk on the server clock: Hospital day 1 → 2 → 3 with real recordings; Nursing Home visits 1 → 4 weeks apart

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

New local lane manual: status failed in manual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: partly): chromium spec. Hospital: day 1 (page.clock = yesterday): the typed note goes in through the Encounter Notes box (autosave), then a bedside recording with the e2e speech stub; the day-1 page is closed. Day 2 (real clock): a new recording, then the Encounter tab. Day 3: chart aged 24 h, tab opened without recording (recorded: day-1/day-2 listing, archive stamps). On main a stopped recording starts Generate Note & Finish by itself, so ai/notes:generateNote is answered with a failure at the socket (no model call). Nursing Home: four visits a week apart, aged 7 days between visits, twice: visit text written by snf:update, and visit text typed in the Encounter tab box (the app's own autosave). Code-read cell: Nursing Home has no bedside recorder at e02167f. — The archive rule and the visit-count rule are server/stamp driven and checkable. The real microphone recording on a device (the 'real recordings' half) needs a person with a phone; day-3 calendar-vs-hours is Q1/Q12 (recorded).

Detail:

8/12 judged cells pass, 3 recorded. Fail: Encounter-tab visit text, after visit 3: the Encounter tab lists V2, V3 only [U7] | Encounter-tab visit text, after visit 4: the Encounter tab lists V3, V4 only [U7] | after visit 3: the Encounter tab lists V2, V3 only [U7] | after visit 4: the Encounter tab lists V3, V4 only [U7]. Recorded: day 3: day 1 gone and day 2 listed as yesterday (Q1 calendar vs hours, Q12) = {"prior":["Oct 12 · Encounter notes","Oct 12 (prior)"],"day1ListedAsPrior":true,"day2ListedAsPrior":false,"day1StillStored":true,"day2InWork | day 3: archive stamps on the prior entries (bedside '(prior)' rows carry no archivedAt, so the 48 h prune never removes them) = [{"label":"Oct 12 · Encounter notes","archivedAt":"2026-10-13T07:49:56.460Z"},{"label":"Oct 12 (prior)","archivedAt":null}] | code read: Nursing Home has a bedside recorder that writes '(prior)' transcript entries = {"recorderFilesInSrcFeaturesSnf":[],"convexSnfCallsApplyTranscriptArchive":false}.

Product issue: Ungated fail (TC-16 U7 has gate None), same root cause as TFA-94699 (Nursing Home last two visits; main SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3). After visit 3 the Encounter tab lists V1, V2 and V3, and after visit 4 it lists V2, V3 and V4; the UAT expects the last two (UAT 3.6, TFA-92594 AC 2). Same result whether the visit text is written by snf:update or typed in the Encounter tab box (the app's autosave). The Hospital day-1 → day-2 cells pass. Recorded, not judged (Q1/Q12): on day 3 the day-1 recording is still listed ('<date> (prior)' entries from the bedside path carry no archivedAt, so the 48 h prune in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts never removes them) and day 2 is not listed as prior (it stays the working transcript until the next recording).

During the run (runNote): On main a stopped bedside recording (and a completed encounter dictation) starts Generate Note & Finish by itself (useGenerateAfterCapture). Earlier runs today let that Generate reach the model (forbidden locally); the specs now answer ai/notes:generateNote with a failure at the socket. In two local runs where the auto-Generate did run (15:58, 16:09 JST; the typed day-1 note was then written by rounding:update with the day-1 page still open), the typed day-1 note was gone from both the box and the prior list on day 2; with Generate withheld and the note typed in the box it is listed. Worth checking on dev, where Generate runs.

Manual checklist (manualChecklist):

  • [TC-16/S14 the real-microphone half: Quinn set microphone / speaker dictation aside on 10-14, so this is not scheduled for now]
  • If it is done later: about 5 minutes a day on 2–3 days in a row (not one 5-minute session), local stack, Chrome on the Mac (not the store / TestFlight build).
  • Day 1: open a QA patient → Encounter → Start bedside recording, say "QA16-DAY1 the cough is better" → Stop; type QA16-DAY1-TYPED into Encounter notes. Note: on main, stopping the recording starts Generate Note & Finish automatically.
  • Day 2: record another sentence for the same patient → Stop → look at Prior Encounter Transcripts: day 1's recording is its own row, dated day 1; the sentence typed on day 1 is no longer in the input box and shows in the list.
  • Day 3: only open, do not record: note whether day 1 is still there and whether day 2 is listed as "yesterday" (Q1 / Q12 not decided, record only).
  • The automated half (desktop browser + speech stub + page.clock, Generate stopped at the socket) has already run; this checklist only adds the real microphone / real device part.

Evidence: 18 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper's server-clock offset and page.clock in the browser (the given puts it on the local stack); dev's server clock cannot be moved and dev has no admin key, so it stays a local-stack case (manual until the helper exists).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
